guidance.promptSnippet: Ask only for blocking user-owned decisions, with enough context and trade-offs to answer without reviewing prior work
promptGuidelines: Before using ask_user_question, inspect the active plan, current checkpoint, approved decisions, and available evidence. Ask only for a concrete blocking decision the user owns; do not ask the user to restate recorded information or decide matters already governed by the plan or repository policy.

Make every question self-contained in plain language. Briefly state the current goal, relevant current state, exact decision, why it is needed now, and the safe default if the user declines or defers. If that context does not fit clearly in the dialog, give a concise chat briefing before asking one structured question.

Use 2-4 concise, distinct options. Each option description must explain its outcome and material trade-offs, including relevant benefits, costs, risks, constraints, and reversibility; do not repeat the label. Put the recommended option first, append (Recommended) to its label, and explain why it is preferred.

Use options[].preview for concrete UI layouts, information architecture, workflow sequences, component ownership, data relationships, implementation boundaries, diagrams, code, or configuration when a visual comparison is clearer and more compact than prose. Do not use previews for simple preferences or multi-select questions.

Default to no question. Ask one question only when a material user-owned decision blocks the current checkpoint and no documented or safely reversible default exists. Ask two only when the decisions are inseparable and both must be answered now. Record later decisions and defer them until their checkpoint. Never exceed four, batch unrelated decisions, or stack questionnaire calls back-to-back.

Use multiSelect only when choices are not mutually exclusive. The interface adds a Type something. row automatically; never author Other or Type something. as option labels. If the user declines and no stated safe default exists, stop only the blocked seam and report what remains blocked.
